exercise1.prompt: Change Over Time: Count the rises

hiddenCases.name: a series that only falls has no rises
a single value has no step to judge
a flat step is not a rise
the right tool does the work

exercise1.hint: diff() gives the change at each step, with the first one missing. Count how many of those are above zero — a missing value is not, so it takes care of itself.

exercise2.prompt: Change Over Time: Growth, honestly reported

hiddenCases.name: the first step is dropped, not zeroed
a single value has no growth at all
a flat series grows by nothing
a fall is reported as negative

exercise2.hint: pct_change() gives proportions with the first row missing. Multiply by 100, round to one place, dropna() and tolist(). Filling the first row with 0 would claim a flat period nobody measured.

choices: The difference from the previous row
questions.explain: And the first row has nothing before it, so it is NaN.
It is a proportion, so multiply by 100 only when formatting for a reader.

questions.prompt: Which row has neither a difference nor a growth rate?
questions.explain: Nothing precedes it. Dropping it or reporting it as unknown are both honest; filling it with 0 is not.
"Grew from nothing" is a sentence, not a percentage, and inf is pandas saying exactly that.
